english.title: Use another to look after / hide / transport an offensive weapon / knife / blade - Violent Crime Reduction Act 2006
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), to look after, hide or transport a dangerous weapon, namely

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY A WEAPON TO WHICH SECTION 141 OF THE CRIMINAL JUSTICE ACT 1988 APPLIES..),]_
(B)_[a knife,]_
(C)_[a knife blade,]_
(D)_[a razor blade,]_
(E)_[an axe,]_
(F)_[an article which had a blade or was sharply pointed and which was made or adapted for use for causing injury to the person , namely **(..SPECIFY THE ARTICLE..),]_

for you under arrangements or in circumstances that facilitated, or were intended to facilitate, that weapon being available to you for an unlawful purpose
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 28 and 29(2) of the Violent Crime Reduction Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

a s 141 CJA 88 weapon/knife/knife blade/razor blade/axe/article

in circumstances that facilitate OR

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 28(1) provides interpretation of 'available for an unlawful purpose', and section 28(3) defines 'dangerous weapon'.
(ii) Children - where this offence was committed by an adult using a minor to look after, hide or transport the weapon this fact must be treated as an aggravating factor in sentencing, see section 70 of the Sentencing Act 2020.

other.penalty:
Indictment: maximum 4 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

A minimum sentence may apply to this offence, see section 311 of, and Schedule 20 to, the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
